name: data.gov.uk CKAN API
description:
The UK Government open data portal API, powered by CKAN. Provides read access to UK government datasets (packages), resources, organisations (publishers), groups and tags published through the data.gov.uk platform.

No API key is required and there are no rate limits. Actions are invoked against the action API base URL documented at https://guidance.data.gov.uk/get_data/api_documentation/ ; parameters are supplied as URL query string values and every response is a JSON envelope with `success`, `result` and `help` fields.

Note: data.gov.uk exposes a read-only subset of the CKAN action API. Only the dataset (package) and organisation (publisher) list/show/search actions documented at the source URL are publicly available; other CKAN actions return HTTP 403.
